articles.title: Heading Home: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 Concludes Station Science Mission
articles.summary: NASA’s SpaceX Crew-12 mission is ending, with the crew scheduled to return in early October. articles.title: NASA Campaign Explores Clouds Spawned by Wildfires
articles.summary: The Wildhorse grass fire in eastern Idaho erupted with a massive pulse of smoke. No one had expected it, but the wildfire had launched what’s known as a pyrocumulonimbus cloud, or pyroCb. It was an elusive weather phenomenon that scientists on NASA’s INSPYRE (INjected Smoke and PYRocumulonimbus Experiment) campaign spent weeks this summer hunting across […]

articles.title: Portugal’s Omnidea Acquires Orbex Assets, Plans PrimeNEO Rocket
articles.summary:
Portuguese space technology group Omnidea has acquired most of Orbex’s intellectual property and UK assets after the rocket builder collapsed into administration in February. Omnidea plans to develop an evolution of Orbex’s small launch vehicle called PrimeNEO.
